subject: Overtraining traps hippocampal dopamine in chronic elevation
script: From Agewell Brief: Overtraining traps hippocampal dopamine in chronic elevation. Exhaustive physical training without adequate recovery destabilizes neural feedback loops, leaving baseline dopamine abnormally elevated at rest. Biological systems rely on rhythmic oscillations between energy expenditure and thermodynamic restoration to maintain cellular integrity.
